name: Acrobat
description:
Description from the publisher:

Acrobat is an exciting game of skill by Janod.

Take turns rolling the dice and strategically placing your acrobats on the spotty board to build the tallest tower but be careful not to let it collapse!

This fun Acrobat game is like Jenga meets Twister and can be enjoyed be the whole family!

The game includes: 20 cardboard discs, 57 wooden acrobat pawns, 3 dice and rule book.

2017 Hot Diggity Awards: Best family and kids game of the year
